Count Costin was a man from Salusa Secundus, the son of Count Palaigo Corrino. He was the father of Sheuset I Costin I, who later became the first Emperor of the Known Universe and founded House Corrino.

page.overview:
Who is Costin?

Count Costin was a man from Salusa Secundus, the son of Count Palaigo Corrino. He was the father of Sheuset I Costin I, who later became the first Emperor of the Known Universe and founded House Corrino.

According to the unproven tradition of House Harkonnen, the earliest Harkonnen mentioned in historical records, Harkonnen Obeshev, was a demibrother of Count Costin and thus also a son of Count Palaigo.
